description: List the paragraph styles (Absatzformate) of the document, including those in style groups: styles[] {name, style_id, group ("" at top level, "Group/Subgroup" nested), based_on, font_family, font_style, point_size, leading_pt (null when automatic), leading_auto, fill_swatch, alignment, space_before_pt, space_after_pt, hyphenation, tracking, keep_options, hyphenation_options, justification_options, drop_cap {lines, characters, character_style}, pdf_tag (PDF export tag, "" = none)} and the character styles (Zeichenformate) as character_styles[] {name, style_id, group, based_on, font_family, font_style, point_size, fill_swatch, tracking – null for attributes the style does not set, pdf_tag}. Each paragraph style also carries indents {left_indent_mm, first_line_indent_mm, right_indent_mm, last_line_indent_mm, tab_stops[], language}, align_to_baseline_grid, capitalization, paragraph_rules {above, below: {on, weight_pt, type, color, tint, offset_mm, left_indent_mm, right_indent_mm, width column|text|frame}} (Absatzlinien), span_columns {type single_column|span_columns|split_columns, count, space_before_mm, space_after_mm, inside_gutter_mm, outside_gutter_mm} (Spaltenspanne) and character {underline, strikethrough, baseline_shift_pt, position}; each character style also language, baseline_shift_pt, position (normal, superscript, subscript …), underline and strikethrough – null when the style leaves them alone. Internal styles whose name starts with "[" are excluded (internal_styles_excluded counts them). Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: list_paragraph_styles
title: List paragraph and character styles
